Where is my character?

Four ways to locate a codepoint.

1. You know the name

Look it up in the NamesList.txt from the database. In 0.1.0 the registry blocks are named; per-codepoint names arrive with native allocations in 0.2.0.

2. You know the range or block

Browse Blocks.txt or the charts. Blocks are named runs; every block belongs to exactly one of the three spaces.

3. You know a property

Query Props/PropList.txt and the derived tables for properties such as Printable, Trap_Instruction or Sentinel_Value. See properties »

4. It is a plugin codepoint

Codepoints above 0x7FFFFFFF belong to plugins. Check the ExtSUCS registry, which maps plugins to their ranges, then the plugin’s own names and properties tables.
